notes.title: v1.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Directors,

We have deployed a new minor patch primarily targeted at fixing a number of issues found in the main game and The Voice Beyond DLC.

[h2]Game Systems & Balance[/h2]

[h3]Ratings Goal Balance[/h3]

[b]Designers Note: [/b]With the release of Patch 1.2 we loosened some of the tension of a number of ratings goals to ensure they were attainable and maintainable within a reasonable timescale and allowing for edgecases. 

Patient & Staff Mood required a little more tweaking to achieve our aims as the system is more susceptible to fluctuations due to environmental factors. So we’ve loosened it some more, this should be much more maintainable now!

[b]Reduced Staff & Patient “Good” Need Goals by an absolute 5% across the board.[/b]
[list]
[*] Mood Goal reduced from 90% to 85%
[*] Nutrition Goal reduced from 90% to 85%
[*] Toilet Goal reduced from 90% to 85%
[*] Seating Goal reduced from 90% to 85%
[/list]

[b]Unified neutral scores for Staff & Patient Need Goals.[/b]
[list]
[*] Staff Mood Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 70%
[*] Staff Nutrition Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 70%
[*] Staff Toilet Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 70%
[*] Staff Seating Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 70%
[*] Patient Nutrition Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 50%
[*] Patient Toilet Neutral Range reduced from 80% to 50%
[/list]

[h3]Campaign[/h3]

[b]Designers Note: [/b]Chapter 8 of the main campaign features a unique reduction in income from treatments. While this was accounted for in the ratings goals it was still a little harder to achieve than we liked, so we’ve adjusted the goal to be closer to the amount of income lost.

[list]
[*] Reduced Chapter 8 Finances Goal by 38% relatively
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Achievement Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] “Multi-Platinum Medicine” - Chapter 2’s Challenge Mode 5-Star Rating Achievement should now unlock correctly. If already completed, simply entering the level should award the achievement.
[*] “It’s All Coming Together” - The Voice Beyond Chapter 2’s Challenge Mode 5-Star Rating Achievement should now unlock correctly. If already completed, simply entering the level should award the achievement.
[*] Fixed edge-cases in which the 5-Star and 5-Star Challenge Mode achievements for The Voice Beyond Chapters 1-3 could not unlock correctly
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Conditions not encountered by the player are no longer considered valid targets for the Research Room’s automatic research selection
[*] Saboteurs which are actively pathing should now die immediately upon clicking the disintegrate button
[/list]

[h3]UI Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The CABAL Abbatoir Model is now correctly purchaseable in the Galactic Exchange
[*] Artifacts should no longer disappear from or be duplicated in the player’s inventory
[*] Fixed an issue where unexpected elements were appearing in the research target list
[/list]

[h3]Campaign Fixes[/h3]
[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where HEAL identified the wrong mutation in chapter 3 of The Voice Beyond
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Return to Sender” objective in The Voice Beyond Chapter 3 did not complete correctly
[/list]

[h3]Visual Fixes[/h3]
[list]

[*] Fixed a number of conflicting visual accessories for Xil and Dyonai patients which would interfere with certain conditions
[*] Fixed a case where certain Xil Accessories would appear too frequently
[*] Fixed a case where some Ohde Accessories would appear on the Xil
[*] Fixed the curious case of the missing nose on Dyonai afflicted by Glacial Cortext
[*] Fixed a missing texture of belt accesories for some species
[/list]

[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where canister conditions could randomly mutate in challenge mode
[*] Fixed some rare issues which could cause save corruption
[*] Fixed a rare issue where you could become hard-locked on a loading screen
[*] Fixed minor issues in the Ohde & Tenki's society/physiology details
[*] Fixed a crash caused by characters becoming stuck
[*] Fixed a few errant audio timings
[/list]

Until next time,

- Brightrock Games

notes.title: MAJOR NEW STORY DLC 'THE VOICE BEYOND' - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]URGENT TRANSMISSION. DIRECTOR'S EYES ONLY.[/h2]

Life. Liberty. Public Health.
The sacred pillars of a civilized galaxy.

But the galaxy burns and the very survival of free space is in peril. 

The CABAL has returned. Ruthless. Unseen. Absurdly dedicated to snuffing out all life. They move through the galaxy like a plague, leaving devastation, conspiracies, and plumbing catastrophes in their wake.

I'm afraid, Director, war is upon us…

[b][i]Galacticare: The Voice Beyond[/i]. A brand new narrative DLC. Available [u]NOW[/u]!!![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334930/Galacticare__The_Voice_Beyond/

[previewyoutube=hY2T3Xt2o9k;full][/previewyoutube]
Do you have the nerve to outmaneuver the CABAL over [b]three all-new fully voiced narrative campaign levels[/b]? Stitching together the pulped remains of war-ravaged warriors and holding the line against a galaxy teetering on the brink?

For you see, Director, as the fearless leader of Galacticare, you are no mere hospital administrator - the sick and wounded of this battle rely on you.

And so does the fate of the cosmos. No pressure.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNjBqNWR3Y3F5bjVwY2cwemxoZ3JrZWs2MGdteDlzc3d6OWx0M3I1diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Pudic9ecPHqUnFpqsn/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][h3]They Ain't Fighting Fair[/h3][/b]
In [i]The Voice Beyond[/i], your enemy's tactics are dirty. Saboteurs - adorable ape-like aliens turned tiny Terminators - will overrun your facility FAST. Deploy Security Craftech to sniff out these foul fiends before they can do any real damage.

Seriously. These loathsome little lads love to blow up a toilet (and we don't mean in the post-kebab kind of fashion).

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbjZyc3B3MW5ya2NhcThmNDFpNDd0YWRwNWNnM3RheGJ5amE3ajVvaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/dC1zdkBEjDommAlMed/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][h3]New Diseases Galore[/h3][/b]
That expensive intergalactic medical degree of yours? Let's hope it’s up to snuff. In [i]The Voice Beyond[/i], you'll be encountering stomach-churning new ailments the likes of which contemporary science is simply ill-equipped. Ha ha. That was wordplay. At any rate, "contemporary" for us means 200 years into the future, so - good luck, 21st century dweller.
[b][list]
[*] Rave Rash
[*] Voxelitis
[*] Fester Fungus
[*] Zynger Sting
[*] Good grief… and there are even MORE?
[/list][/b]
Amidst the madness, do your damndest to remain calm and ensure your patients stay healthy, happy, flirty, and thriving. Well, maybe not flirty.

[b][h3]Only The Strong Survive[/h3][/b]
This will be your toughest shift yet. Snatch entire species from the jaws of extinction, stitch their shattered bodies back together, and return them to the meat grinder of galactic war. From triaging Laserated Xil warriors to killing an ancient cosmic god, only the most professional healthcare professionals can turn the tide in this almighty engagement.

Wait a minute, what was that about killing an ancient cosmic god...?

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExanppYWU4ZXVvenpseGk5bWhhMHdkeWptNGt3YTZpMmI2cHRodGE5YyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/T2rBoFaqt5pOM96WL3/giphy.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Kill An Ancient Cosmic God[/h3][/b]
Something, somewhere, is pulling the strings. Their motives are unknown. Their reach is absolute. And yet, the question remains: why? And, more pressingly… [b]yo, where can I buy this DLC? A [u]launch discount for the next two weeks[/u] would be sweet, actually.[/b]

Oh we've got your back -

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334930/Galacticare__The_Voice_Beyond/

And cor blimey, [b]you can also purchase the DLC as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LondonGamesFestival2025]LONDON GAMES FESTIVAL[/url] sale on Steam, running April 2nd to April 13th.[/b] 'Ave a banana!

[h2][i]GALACTICARE: THE VOICE BEYOND[/i][/h2]

So scrub in, suit up, and prepare for the most chaotic hospital shift in the history of the universe. The fate of all sentient life is in your hands, Director. Will you rally your staff, heal the wounded, and defeat the CABAL? Or will your medical empire be reduced to space dust?

[b]End transmission.[/b]

notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Brace yourselves, [i]Galacticare[/i] fans: [b]TODAY'S THE DAY![/b] 

The new expansion is LIVE, and it's packing more chaos than a flaming Boning Chamber in the middle of an influx of urgent patients with Skeletal Trauma! 

We've loaded it up with a ton of wild new features to keep you on your toes, plus a few tweaks and fixes to make sure things don't implode (unless you want them to). The galaxy burns and Galacticare is headed to the frontlines!

The fate of all sentient life is in your hands.

So… scrub in, suit up, and prepare for the most chaotic hospital shift in the history of the universe.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334930/Galacticare__The_Voice_Beyond/

[b]Here's everything headed your way in Version 1.2![/b]

[h1]"The Voice Beyond" - The Epic New Paid Expansion[/h1]

In [i]Galacticare: The Voice Beyond[/i], saving lives is just the beginning of our monumental struggle. The CABAL has returned, unyielding and relentless, bent upon the utter destruction of all we hold dear. As the indomitable leader of Galacticare, the weight of the galaxy's survival rests upon your shoulders. You must rise to confront not only new and bizarre afflictions, like Perceptual Parapox and Rave Rash, but also the unseen saboteurs within your very hospital who plot to end your efforts from the shadows.

Victory will not be won by force of arms, but by the strength of research, the ingenuity of Medibots, and the unshakable resolve of those who rally to your cause. Will you rise to this challenge, or will all life in the galaxy fall into eternal darkness? The time to act is now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pDdjOYk.png[/img]

[h2]Exciting New Content for the DLC[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]3 Thrilling, Fully Voiced Story Levels -[/b] Continue the adventure beyond the original [i]Galacticare[/i] as you dive into new, voice-acted chapters that will test your leadership like never before!
[*] [b]New Events & Challenges -[/b] Brace yourself for an onslaught of new events designed to push your problem-solving and management skills to the limit.
[*] [b]New Rewards & Objects -[/b] Unlock a treasure trove of exciting new rewards, gadgets, and objects to aid in your mission to save the galaxy.
[*] [b]New Skins for Consultants and Medi -[/b] Style meets strategy with fresh new skins for your consultants and, of course, Medi. Because let's face it, everyone loves Medi!
[*] [b]New Sandbox Events -[/b] Enjoy the freedom of new sandbox events that will let you experiment and explore the full potential of your hospital and its resources.
[/list]
[h2]Out-of-This-World DLC Gameplay Features[/h2]

[b]Prepare for the Ultimate Challenge with Saboteurs![/b]
Saboteurs will infiltrate your hospital, masquerading as Tenki patients, and wreak havoc on your operations. These sneaky fiends will destroy your meticulously planned toilet systems, fill your bins to overflowing, and generally make a mess of your well-oiled machines. It's up to you to root them out with ruthless efficiency. No quarter given!

[b]New Tech: Intrusion Sensors & Security Holodrones[/b]
Defend your hospital with cutting-edge tech! Intrusion Sensors will allow you to detect these vile Saboteurs before they can do too much damage, while Security Holodrones will track them down and neutralize the threat with swift, fiery retribution.

[b]Meet the REBEL Consultant[/b]
Introducing the ultimate wildcard: REBEL! A former CABAL agent with the uncanny ability to mimic the skills of your other consultants. Double the power, double the results! This rogue agent will give your team the edge it needs to outwit the CABAL.

[b]Bonus: New Skins for Your Consultants (and Medi, of course)[/b]
Because no consultant should feel anything less than battle-ready, we’ve added an array of stylish new skins for your trusty team of experts and iconic characters.

[b]Check out the new expansion for [i]Galacticare[/i] TODAY![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334930/Galacticare__The_Voice_Beyond/

[h1]Base Game Free Updates[/h1]

But fear not, Director - we're also rolling out free updates and patches to the original game. Alongside the thrilling new narrative arc in the DLC, we've continued to fine-tune and improve everything you love about [i]Galacticare[/i] - from the core gameplay to our nefariously hard Challenge Mode.

[h1]Game Systems & Balance[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[b]New Ongoing Research Projects[/b]
New Ongoing Research Projects are available in the Research Lab, providing passive bonuses for each doctor assigned to them

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[b]Adjusted spawner behaviour in Sandbox Mode[/b]
[list][*]Patients with conditions that utilise rooms that were not available in the level's story mode will not appear
[*]The player can override this behaviour by placing such rooms, this will cause patients to spawn that are relevant to those rooms[/list]
[*]This behaviour is overridden if the player builds rooms 
[list]
[*] Balanced the rate of initial wave of patients spawning in train levels and elevator levels
[*] Randomized the entrance that mutation patients come in from
[*] Made changes to no longer allow the same event to play twice
[*] Xil species desire mood values update to compensate for the fact that Xil don't actually have the tidyness/mess thoughts anymore
[/list]
[b]Challenge Mode Balance Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the average time between mutation events by 100%
[*] Health Decay at Danger Level 3 reduced by 2.8%
[*] Health Decay for Mutated Conditions reduced by 18.8%
[/list]
[b]Rebalanced Hospital Ratings:[/b]
[list]
[*] Species Desires reduced by 20% on average
[*] Treatment Rate requirements reduced by 10%
[*] Patient Health & Treatment Quality requirements reduced by 6%
[*] Finance requirements reduced by ~14.5%
[*] Throughput requirements reduced by ~14.5%
[*] Several rating requirements now scale throughout the campaign, peaking in later levels
[/list]
[h1]Campaign[/h1]

[h2]Chapters[/h2]

Fixed issues with Chapter 8 of the original Galacticare base game

[h1]Visuals[/h1]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]

Updated Xil & Dyonai accessories

[list]
[*] Fixed fish tank prop causing transparency sorting issues
[*] Fixed several missing elements in Chapter 11's cutscenes

[*] Fixed Tenki special repair gun shooting VFX out of bum instead of gun

[*] Fixed Traumatology red printer blobs flying all over sometimes. Maybe.
[*] Fixed issues with Divergence condition
[*] Fixed patients going missing in the Xtra Ray
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Performance improvements in patient/staff overview panels
[*] Added new element to Research room panel showing how many doctors are researching the room's current target
[*] Can now open/close pause menu in galaxy view using Escape/Gamepad-Start buttons
[/list]
[h2]UI Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed gamepad prompts to avoid buttons getting stuck

[*] Fixed doctors working in research labs that appeared as unassigned in the Staff Overview
[*] Fixed consultant hero portraits showing as locked in Chapter 11

[*] Fixed casualty status of room not getting cleared in UI

[*] Fixed Brother Gumbo's "No Salary" trait not working at all, including UI representation of it
[*] Fixed Challenge Mode's loss block being visible when hovered even when invisible
[*] Fixed Challenge Mode death timer not clearing when switching levels
[*] Fixed tooltip updates when recruiting consultants
[*] Fixed a reverse check on consultant panel
[*] Fixed Laser Burns not showing correctly in portraits
[*] Certain dialogue skips now have an explicit "ongoing process please wait" on skip button click
[*] Fixed Medi having thoughts when using mood lens
[*] Updated Missing icons in tasks

[*] Fixed assignment button states for doctors on their way to a training bed
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Research rooms now target a new set of research when the original has fully completed

[*] Clicking Hallow Soul or Twiggy Pop will no longer trigger click reaction audio

[*] Fixed research progress not increasing

[*] Fixed floor decals not being available after purchase in Loamium shop
[*] Fixed room lighting not working in all rooms
[*] Fixed timing on when rewards are given to properly line up with animations
[*] Fixed an issue where only 1 cannon was able to play the fire & load SFX
[*] Reduced the Earl Prince's Effective XP gain from Chitters to intended levels

[*] Fixed a case that could prevent achievements from unlocking when achieving 5-stars in a given level in normal or challenge modes

notes.title: Patient Overload - Challenge Mode DLC
notes.content:
Greetings, Directors!

In our recently-released Challenge Mode DLC, one of the many delights that await you is our patented Patient Overload – a system hand-built to test your staff and hospital to their frazzled limits.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExajByNmVqb3k5bmZqcnM2N2JteGJoamZ4Mm9iM3o0emN2czFhczE5biZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/uXqoxrc1KOTxpb7g12/giphy.gif[/img]

Over time, a swarm of inconsiderate, disruptive patients will traipse into your hospital demanding immediate care, and requiring you use your hard-earned space money on more treatment facilities.

Every patient needs your personal attention for their survival, but these particular patients will arrive with a wider range of initial health. Be quick as every condition now kills patients faster than it did previously. Leave them too long and you'll pay hefty fines.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnhrM2V3NzRpMTdybTg0enpubnRxcm9keWkyem9qZXdqcWZsbHUydiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RjgWEMORGefwZBgXco/giphy.gif[/img]

Having qualified staff and experts in your employ may help, but it’s vital to the success of your hospital that they’re the best of the best. Get them researching ASAP or risk your patients’ doom! Or worse, the authorities will shut the hospital down, and everyone’ll end up going to jail.

Best of luck, and so on.

Until next time, Directors!
- Brightrock & CULT

notes.title: Challenge Mode is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Greetings Directors!

Challenge Mode is our new FREE DLC full of unrelenting stress for the management masochists! You thought our game was too [i]easy[/i]. 

Well, feedback received; we've worked day and night twiddling our knobs and levers into a diabolical arrangement that's sure to make even the most experienced director perspirate. As they say, be careful what you wish for.

[previewyoutube=jzpyb2OxiLg;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure your game is fully updated to play! [b]See the full patch notes summary below.[/b]

[h2][b]Patient Overload![/b][/h2]

Swarms of inconsiderate patients will barge into your hospital on the brink of death – often requiring rooms you’ve yet to build. But be quick, as every condition now kills patients quicker than it did previously. Leave them too long and you'll pay hefty fines. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7CM9kfeLs6DnABZlf7/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2][b]They're [i]Mutating?![/i][/b][/h2]

At any moment one of your previously discovered conditions can mutate into a far deadlier variant strain. A perfect time to get those doctors you forgot to fire into the Research Lab, I’d say.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/IJUQvfsK4Ckvhv1Zi8/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Goodbye, Money![/b][/h2]

We hope you’re responsible with your finances because you’ll be burning holes in your pockets keeping up with patients’ vexing needs and staff demands. Say goodbye to your money, we’re robbing you of credits and free items.

And don’t even think about crying to Baz, he won’t be any help. The generous colossal is now a colossal ****. Baz’s freebies will now only consist of cheap consumables. You’ll have to pay full price for everything else!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gJM8PBuoc905Q4aViA/giphy.gif[/img]

Fine, we’ll allow you to use The Research Lab, Training Room, Recovery Ward and Craftech immediately. You’ll need them in order to avoid killing too many patients.


[h1]Patch v1.1.0[/h1]
[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]
[list]
[*]Challenge Mode is available is an optional setting that can be enabled when starting any level (both story and sandbox) if you enjoy suffering and misery
[*]In order to experience challenge mode on a level you’ll need to start again from scratch, it cannot be enabled in an already-existing hospital
[*]All career progress (research, consultants, unlocks, etc) is shared between challenge mode and regular mode
[*]Each level has an additional cosmetic reward available for reaching a 5 star hospital rating in challenge mode (it’s quite hard)
[*]Several new achievements are also available for reaching 5 stars in challenge mode
[/list]
[b]All of the features and changes listed below are exclusive to challenge mode, and do not impact regular gameplay![/b]
[h2]Mutated Conditions![/h2]
[i]Conditions have begun to mutate into deadly new strains, and it’s a race against time to research the cures before your hospital is flooded with death and disaster. Put those nerds in the Research Lab to work before it’s too late![/i]
[list]
[*]Conditions now randomly mutate, massively increasing their treatment difficulty, health decay rate, and patient spawn rate
[*]Mutated conditions do not benefit from any existing research bonuses (they are effectively research level 0)
[*]All mutated conditions are the same difficulty level, regardless of their original difficulty
Mutations must be researched (via normal means or by making use of the Research Lab) in order to re-discover the treatment, at which point the mutation is cleared
[*]Successfully clearing a mutation results in a bounty of credits and Loamite
[/list]
[h2]More Patients![/h2]
[i]Infection rates have surged and HEAL’s “KPI safeties” were switched off because they were illegal, so keep an eye on the shuttle bays – the goddamned patients are coming in hordes![/i]
[list]
[*]A new “Challenge Spawner” system will progressively increase the number of patients spawning, regardless of if your hospital is also growing in size
[*]Patients are more likely to require rooms you haven’t yet built and enter with less health than usual
[/list]
[h2]More Death![/h2]
[i]The cost of MEDI’s body-disposal tech was extortionate but, with the state of these patients, it’s about to save us a fortune on body bags.[/i]
[list]
[*]Conditions of every danger level will cause patients to deteriorate faster than before - even danger level 0 conditions have health decay now!
[*]Treatments are harder to perform, and more likely to result in patient fatalities if your doctors are unhappy, tired, or poorly trained
[/list]
[h2]More Poverty![/h2]
[i]By 2049, medical debt exceeded 1,800% of global GDP, and the entire economy turned into mashed potatoes. The ghost of that terrible time has returned, and both we and our patients are flat broke.[/i]
[list]
[*]Income from treatments is 20%~ lower
[*]Travelling merchants will no longer offer room upgrades or corridor upgrades for free - the only freebies still available are cheap consumables, you’ll have to pay full-price for everything else!
[/list]
[h2]New Ways to Lose![/h2]
[i]For those of you lacking a sense of shame, we thought there should be a more tangible penalty for killing all of your patients.[/i]
[list]
[*]If over 25% of your patients die (or leave) for an extended period of time, your hospital will be shut down
[*]This loss condition works the same way as bankruptcy: once the threshold is hit, you have 10 minutes to correct it, after which you will be shut down if the situation hasn’t improved
[/list]
[h2]More!!![/h2]
[i]I’m all out of exclamation points now.[/i]
[list]
[*]Meteor strikes and pest incursions occur with more frequency and a greater intensity
[*]Doctors can only be recruited at rank 1 & 2, all the rank 3 recruits have been hoovered up by the private sector
[*]The Research Lab, Training Room, Recovery Ward and Craftech upgrades are all available from Chapter 1 - without them, you’d be toast
[*]Patients are less patient (they’ll become unhappy waiting sooner than before)
[*]Staff & patients are slightly more unhappy by default, requiring a bit more effort to stave off their existential dread
[/list]
[h1]Game Systems & Balance[/h1]
[h2]Hospital Life[/h2]
[i]We've instilled all the inhabitants of your hospital with a new sense of purpose and wonder in life. They'll react to the happenings around them, to their own moods, admire art on the walls, or puke on the floor. They might even strike up a conversation or two. All this brings a sense of life to the hospital, provided your patients are indeed living that is.[/i]
[list]
[*]Characters will now react when witnessing death and vomit in the corridor (and may even vomit themselves, creating an exquisite chain reaction)
[*]Characters will now play animations to indicate if they are hungry, bored of waiting, or need the toilet
[*]Characters will now cough and sneeze, with increasing frequency if they are close to death
[*]Characters will now stop and have a chat with each other in the corridor
[*]Staff with no work to do will now idle in the Staff Lounge, instead of wondering aimlessly around the corridor
[/list]
[h1]Global Balance Adjustments[/h1]
[i]We’ve made a few balance changes which impact the game both in challenge mode and in regular difficulty.[/i]
[list]
[*]Starting credits in all levels increased from 125,000 to 150,000
[*]The Recovery Ward now heals patients twice as fast
[*]The disruptive spawner is slightly less disruptive outside sandbox mode
[*]Hospital zones are approximately 15% cheaper to unlock
[*]The travelling merchant now visits every 5.5 minutes, up from every 6 minutes
[*]Consultants no longer have inflated salaries at lower levels, but still end up costing more once they have levelled up
[*]The “I See Dead People” thought is now -10% mood (down from -20% mood, because dead people aren’t that bad)
[*]You now start with 500 craftium in all levels and all modes, *except* for MC1 & MC2 in non-challenge story mode (as you haven't been taught to craft yet)
[/list]
[h1]Campaign[/h1]
[h2]Chapter 1[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a part of tutorial where you could pass by doing the wrong thing
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 3[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a randomly highlighted wall
[*]Fixed an issue where cured patients are unable to leave the hospital
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 6[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the level would force all duplicated doctors to be named Otto Ohdious
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 8[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed asteroids doing 0 damage to rooms
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 11[/h2]
[list]
[*]Moved burning moon memory so it stops clipping through
[/list]
[h2]Sandbox[/h2]
[list]
[*]Colossal panel progress bar now correctly updates
[*]Jellified Spiel event now uses the correct Charles Barryborough prefab
[*]Fixed incorrect Avatar appearing on some lines
[/list]
[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made changes to lens colours for better info
[/list]
[h2]Visual Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where an inactive room would have a different wall colour to the rest of the hospital
[*]Put the particle VFX back into the Recovery Ward
[*]Fixed an issue causing conflict between wall props and windows being placed near each other
[*]Fixed an issue where background particles would fly around the hospital
[*]Fixed Charles Barryborough's hair moving weirdly with jellification on it
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added some scroll functionality to level select UI
[*]Hospital Rating is now better presented to the player at the beginning of a level
[*]Assigning staff to a research room through the staff picker will automatically fill up empty assignment slots instead of forcing the player to manually select each slot.
[*]Made changes to how the patient panel is extended
[*]Added tooltip for health that isn't recoverable
[*]Changed the credits tooltip in the closed hospital stage
[*]Research undertaken in other Research Labs now has the 'remove' button in research list
[*]Can now send eligible patients to Recovery Ward through the Patients Overview panel
[/list]
[h2]UI Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed WFTO arcade cabinet tooltip that incorrectly displays 'fulfils nutrition need'
[*]Doctors assigned to Research Labs will not show as Unassigned anymore
[*]Fixed an issue where hospital ratings were not recording deaths (the culprit has not been found)
[*]Fixed misplaced lens icons
[*]Fixed dramatic patients with critical health icon showing when they're non-critical
[*]Fixed the patient reject menu not showing a penalty
[*]Fixed an issue where Research Lab ‘add doctor’ icon remains after selecting doctor
[*]Fixed an issue with Consultant traits stacking up and overflowing the consultant window
[*]Fixed various line breaks/cutoffs on patient tooltip tags
[*]Fixed "Doctor On Break" escalating to a UI notification
[*]Fixed an issue where every single room has 0% Treatment Quality
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the Research Lab panel to open
[*]Fixed Patient Overview panel crash
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made some changes to passive reactions like sneezing and yawning
[*]Research Labs now automatically assign a random research when built/finishing research
[*]Made improvements to how patients move from shuttles into the hospital
[*]Pests are no longer immediately targeted by Medibots when they spawn, and are only detected after being in the hospital for a while or biting a couple of patients
[/list]
[h2]Additional Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where playing a new level would continue the last
[*]Fixed an issue where Ultra's 'Translocation Ray' skill wouldn't work
[*]Fixed an issue causing crashes on PS5
[*]Fixed an issue where patients would rather wait in a long queue than use another available room
[*]Fixed an issue where switching research room tasks would disrupt research
[*]Stabilizing Solution can no longer be used on Baz, sorry Baz.
[*]Fixed an issue with patients complaining about mess even though there is no mess
[*]Fixed an issue where patients assumed the hospital was untidy when entering
[*]Fixed the Diagnosis Room queue distribution system
[*]Fixed an issue where dramatic patients would head to the Recovery Ward despite being full health or fully cured
[*]Fixed an issue with placing props behind other props
[*]Fixed an issue with Stabilizing Solution not doing its job
[*]Fixed an issue where placing a Subsonic Dampener room upgrade decreases number of Efficiency Regulators in the inventory
[*]Fixed an issue where Skin Lab template gets permanently stuck
[*]Fixed an issue where HEAL says you need to buy more vending machine when there is already plenty
[*]Fixed an issue where Kouber Baly Doctors would get stuck in the entrance
[*]Fixed an issue where you can build a room with a canister in it
[*]Fixed Holographic Doctor having 'poor decoration' thought
[*]Fixed pests crawling into the Diagnosis Rooms
[*]Fixed an issue where patients would walk through other patients when close to the benches


Good luck out there, Directors!
 - Brightrock & CULT

We are so grateful for your feedback and support, we’d love to hear what you think of Challenge Mode!

notes.content:
Greetings Directors!

This Galacticare Wednesday we’re robbing you of your credits and free items and there’s nothing you, or your silly little Medibots can do. In the imminent Challenge Mode update, we're hitting you where it hurts the most: right in the budget!

In the interest of keeping things, well, interesting, players will now experience financial hardships, setbacks and even bankruptcy. You’ll need to balance your books, pinch the pennies and cut corners like never before!

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcG85ZHFkemsyd2IyN2E0amQzYm1vOTN1cWd1bHJyeXU3cHFnamhoNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/8zobeprWDjHeoYcyFO/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

While we’ve chosen to make things difficult, YOU are ultimately responsible for the downfall of your hospital. Failing to keep your swarms of patients alive, cleaning up the filth they leave behind, training staff, updating and adding new facilities, and maintaining your hospital rating will lead you to your inevitable doom.

Freebies, in this economy?! If only! No, Baz is depressed, and he’ll be keeping his precious gifts to himself. No more free holo-docs for you, sadly.  

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa2R5YjJnM3M4cHl3ZWlzamdmdjltZTVpOHZxM3B5cHgydXoycjN4bSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/mEOse4J0GRGXqM880j/giphy.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, the more capable doctors have decided to resolve their student debt elsewhere. You’ll have to train high-skilled doctors yourself – or directly pipe the required experience into their panicked brains. 

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeXRxemt0OWZ0MjdncnA5cWUwY3VoZ2JrbHlzOHhkMnV6b3h2YW94NiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/oFSi9qG0pVVlv6v1YW/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

But it’s not all miserable news; If you can actually survive Chapter 1, you’ll unlock The Research Lab, Training Room, Recovery Ward and Craftech upgrades immediately. We’re sure that’ll make you deliriously happy!


Good luck, Directors!
- Brightrock & CULT

[h1]Game Systems & Balance[/h1]

[h2]Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Audio Settings now have 'Mute In Background'
[*] Implemented "quit to desktop" button.
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated thresholds for decorative species desires
[*] The rating multiplier multiplies now and doesn't divide

[h2]Campaign[/h2]
[h3]Chapter 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the first patient wasn’t spawning in the drive through
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 3[/h3]
[list]

[h3]Chapter 8[/h3]

[*] Fixed an issue where level select screen didn't update after using the skip story button
[*] Fixed an issue stopping players from hiring Dyonai and Kouber doctors

[*] Fixed some misbehaving UI icons
[*] Fixed an issue where doctors could not be locked in the Research room
[*] Fixed an issue where conditions overview panel didn't correctly display research progress for each condition
[*] Research room panel now correctly displays both research and insight when researching conditions.
[*] Fixed tooltips of assigned doctors' portraits in the Research room panel
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]

[h2]Additional Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the pest trap refused to trap pests
[*] Fixed an issue where Twiggy Pop would lose a specialist point after the game crashed
[*] Fixed an issue where copying a room would create a ghost room with ghost items around the hospital
[*] Fixed an issue where Dr. Ohdious would refuse to be dismissed
[*] Fixed an issue where placing a room would cause corridor props to disappear
[*] Upped the Xcelohdes initial needs so they don't leave as soon as they get in the hospital
[*] Fixed an issue stopping gamepad users from buying Loamium shop items while in game
[*] Fixed an exploit for infinite room upgrades
[*] Fixed an issue causing people to be teleported inside vending machines
[*] Fixed an issue causing recovery patients to turn blindingly glowy
[*] Fixed an issue stopping players from unlocking the Cabal Cutter achievement
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to not start
[*] Fixed an issue with certain save information missing
[*] Fixed teleporter pads causing everyone to freeze
[*] Fixed 'invalid room build' when removing extra tiles
[*] Fixed patients being slightly more upset than intended in the time between them entering the station and setting food inside the hospital
[/list]

notes.content:
Greetings Directors!

Can’t wait for our new Challenge Mode DLC? We’ve got some exciting teasers for you this Galacticare Wednesday! We should warn you, Directors, this won’t be an easy walk down the milky way!


First is our shiny new Challenge Mode banner at the top of our start menu, and a checkbox to select on the left side of the ‘Play Story’ button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/d5c4202f0ba38c7fd70174365a2aa9e3012d1bba.png[/img]

notes.title: Challenge Mode - Free DLC coming soon!
notes.content:
Does death tickle your fancy but your “friends” keep asking you to change the topic of conversation? The free Challenge Mode DLC is coming soon to satisfy your frankly bizarre tastes with mortality rates that only a Hardcore Hospital Gamer can subdue! If harrowing difficulty isn’t enough, Challenge Mode also brings shiny, golden trophies for the fraction of Directors who survive succeed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/e514fbbbbbbbfb1bd5c32c47cb0fbeb4d05d2fff.png[/img]

[b]MORE PATIENTS = MORE DEATH[/b]

Infection rates have surged and HEAL’s “KPI safeties” were switched off because they were illegal, so  keep an eye on the shuttle bays – the goddamned patients are coming in hordes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/a2bb7d100d35bf114815d69389853b28bfc4d625.png[/img]

[b]MUTATING CONDITIONS[/b]

Conditions have begun to mutate into deadly new strains, and it’s a race against time to research the cures before your hospital is flooded with death and disaster. Put those nerds in the Research Lab to work before it’s too late!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/f28659cfb448f368a4cece7a9cca768937870610.png[/img]

[b]KEEP UP OR LOSE[/b]

Every mechanic has been tuned to provide a more challenging experience from the baseline difficulty. With adjustments to spawners, patient needs, economic balance, patient health, and more, you’ll need to utilise every tool to succeed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/f64289cb9e8b0d58e0276cc44197c18f9618bf5a.png[/img]

Challenge Mode is our response to your masochistic requests for more difficulty, suffering, and general misery. Built to be unforgiving and push players to utilise their full toolset, it’s intended for those who want their Galacticare experience to have a little more bite to it.

Directors, are you ready? Challenge Mode DLC is coming soon

notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
Greetings Director,

We’re continuing to plink away at the feedback you’ve been throwing our way. This update delivers a number of much requested Quality of Life features and many more fixes and improvements elsewhere paving a foundation for more extensive updates that we have in the works.

[h1]Features[/h1]

[h2]“Apply to All” for Medibot Skins[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a button in the Medibot skin selection list which applies the currently-selected skin to all Medibots in the hospital
[/list]
[h2]“Skip Story” Option[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to skip the story and unlock sandbox mode on every map
[*]This will unlock all levels, “complete” all levels, unlock all consultants, unlock all conditions and unlock all Craftech
[*]This will not unlock any reputation or rating rewards
[*]This process cannot be reversed
[*]This option can be found in the settings screen in the game tab
[/list]
[h2]“Reset Profile” Option[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to fully reset your game profile
[*]This will reset all progress and delete all hospitals
[*]This process cannot be reversed, so don’t use it unless you’re sure!
[*]This option can be found in the settings screen in the game tab
[/list]
[h2]Game Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*]Camera zoom in / out is now rebindable (PC only)
[*]Added settings to enable or disable the default prop placement lenses (for decoration, etc)
[*]The default value for sliders is now visually indicated on the slider
[/list]
[h1]Game Systems & Balance[/h1]

[h2]Character Mood & Needs[/h2]
[i][b]Attaining a high average mood value for patients was proving difficult due to the lack of available thoughts they had compared to staff (which also have thoughts for staff lounge capacity and their salary). To compensate, patients now receive a higher mood impact from species desires. We’ve also improved the behaviour of environment-related thoughts in unbuildable areas.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Species Desires now increase and decrease patient mood by 15% (up from 5%) - This is still only 5% for staff
[*]Environmental thoughts (for decoration & mess) are now paused when entering a non-buildable area, instead of being removed entirely - This prevents patients entering an unbuildable area becoming arbitrarily sad without the player being able to do anything about it
[/list]
[h2]Hospital Rating[/h2]
[i][b]We’ve improved the hospital rating system to allow us to make some per-level adjustments. As such, we’ve reduced the throughput and finances rating requirements in a few levels which were particularly tough to get a good rating in, and increased the requirements in all other levels. We’ve also made a few additional adjustments that follow some bug fixes in both 1.0.4 and 1.0.5 which made certain ratings easier to attain than intended.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*]Patient mood requirement increased from 85% to 90%
[*]Staff mood requirement increased from 85% to 90%
[*]Throughput rating requirement reduced by 35% in Chapter 1
[*]Throughput rating requirement reduced by 5% in Chapter 2
[*]Throughput rating requirement increased by 30% in all other levels
[*]Finances rating requirement reduced by 35% in Chapter 8
[*]Finances rating requirement increased by 30% in all other levels
[*]Slightly increased the requirements for several decorative species desires
[/list]
[h1]Campaign[/h1]

[h2]Chapter 1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Throughput rating requirement reduced by 35%
Added an alarming alarm sound effect to the mid-level cutscene
[*]Fixed an issue where the tutorial would highlight consultants for inspection rather than doctors
[*]Medi should now be in the correct place for his introduction cutscene instead of wandering off
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Throughput rating requirement reduced by 5%
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 3[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where trains wouldn't spawn and left patients stuck inside the hospital
[*]Fixed some objective text in Chapter 3
[*]Fixed an issue which caused trains to occasionally disappear
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 4[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where giant tomatoes weren't doing damage to props and rooms
[*]Fixed a rare soft lock caused by canisters wanting to stay in the hospital for ever and ever
[*]Changed the way the canisters react to the end of Big Veg timer, there should now be time for the last canisters to spawn so each canister has the chance to leave without being stuck in the hospital
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 6[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the elevators were erroneously triggering high-congestion thoughts
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 8[/h2]
[list]
[*]Finances rating requirement reduced by 35%
[*]Made changes to the timings of Colossal spawn to better fit the narrative with what's being said
[*]Improved the objective display when treating Klem Banzig
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 9[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with Burger Joint not popping at the right time
[*]Added wait time before you can send off the shuttle to allow both the colossals to fully come in beside the hospital
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 10[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with patients misbehaving in the intro cutscene
[*]Fixed an issue where patient remains would spawn inside areas Medi cant reach for clean ups
[/list]
[h2]Chapter 11[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with cutscenes not showing correctly
[/list]
[h1]Visuals[/h1]

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced the amount of glimmer and shine of hospital floors
[*]Changed the mustard yellow colour on human males
[/list]
[h2]Visual Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where a room would be missing interior textures
[*]Fixed patients teleporting out of corridors during cutscenes
[*]Fixed the doctor’s positioning in the Centrifuge
[*]Fixed consultant skin not showing in the chathead
[*]Fixed an issue where patient death sequence for Nanoscopy didn't play out properly
[*]Fixed a rare issue with highlight rendering
[*]Fixed clipping issues when Xil's would use the toilet
[*]Fixed an issue where patient death sequence for Xtra-Ray didn't play out properly
[*]Fixed Dyonai skin/hair colour mismatch and re-introduced skin variants for a couple of conditions
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cleaned up the appearance of the text in the consultant roster
[*]Rating stars will now glow as they're being filled
[*]Hidden the 'BUILD' button for rooms that aren't yet available to build
[/list]
[h2]UI Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the inventory panel closing instead of showing cursor in craft mode
[*]Fixed the new item highlight being stuck in some areas
[*]Fixed an issue where tutorial highlights would be stuck on the screen
[*]Fixed objective panel sometimes being hidden when a level begins
[*]Fixed an issue where menus could accidentally be clicked through while in game
[*]Fixed 'Video' tab being out of screen in low resolutions
[*]Fixed the Patient/Staff tooltip showing the '%' icon twice
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]

[h2]Localisation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Localised staff species tooltips when recruiting
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made changes to the way Colossals move around in multiple levels
[*]Made it easier for gamepad users to escape menus and notifications
[*]Gamepad users can now continue to adjust the camera while in UI windows
[*]Non console platforms are now saving files in a more crash resistant way.
[*]Some fixes to help the game recover if the player profile becomes corrupted
[*]Made improvements to menu flow on gamepad
[*]Made changes to the length of HEAL's VO
[*]Updated VO timings for incidents
[*]Added zoom in/out as remappable keys in keyboard settings
[*]Updated item tooltips with improved descriptions
[*]Various minor performance improvements
[/list]
[h2]Additional Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Baz's Lucky Tooth (Colossal Artefact) not correctly reducing the cooldown for the travelling merchant
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented rugs from being placed in front of doors
[*]Fixed an issue where patients would teleport quite far from the teleportation pad
[*]Fixed various gamepad navigation issues
[*]Fixed Vizarj click reactions not sounding quite right
[*]Fixed issue with Dr. Ohdious only playing generic Ohde click reactions
[*]Fixed issues with mouse scroll not functioning properly
[*]Fixed an issue where Twiggy Pop skin changes wouldn't show
[*]Fixed an issue where patients couldn't fully die
[*]There was an issue with past saves not being cleaned up. This fixes it and automatically removes older saves. This should help greatly on storage constrained platforms (Xbox/PS/Gog)
[*]Fixed an issue where Earl Prince would stop receiving XP after 30 minutes
[*]Fixed an issue which caused patients to occasionally not queue up for diagnosis
[*]Fixed crash occurring when players sent patients to the end of a queue
[*]Fixed a very rare issue which caused tutorial pop-ups to lock the game when playing on gamepad
[*]Implemented a failsafe to prevent crashing while saving on PS5
[*]Fixed an issue where deleting the Recovery Ward would force patients inside to be stuck
[*]Fixed an issue where patients would see Twiggy Pop and leave without being properly cured
[*]Fixed issue with Centrifuge interactions
[*]Fixed an issue where canisters for colossal diagnosis were spawning outside of the shuttle
[*]Fixed issues with the UI getting stuck when switching between Gamepad and Keyboard/Mouse input
[*]Missing Medi lines have been added back in
[*]Fixed an issue preventing hospital rating to reach 5 stars in some cases
[*]Fixed some issues with Colossal VO
[*]Fixed an issue where HEAL would be stuck repeating himself for the rest of eternity at the end of a level
[/list]
[b]Until next time Director,

Brightrock & CULT[/b]

notes.title: Galacticare Steam Community Items
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back to Galacticare Wednesday![/b]

For any collectors out there, we have something for you.
Today we are rolling out Community Items on Steam which include Galacticare Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons & Backgrounds.


[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/44acdca01b8ee1d9ca81cf0850cb6f0912c0e702.png[/img]

In total, there are 12 Trading cards.

Half the card set is received while playing Galacticare (based on playtime in the game), the other half is earned through collecting (trading with or buying from other users through Steam and the Steam Community Market)

Each trading card is based on a different character in Galacticare, and each of them have their own poster image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/1e23cdd67b7a10bace8cd1fa08c00cb75be2e3d5.png[/img]


[h1]Badges[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/974d90468e0ab1e4c493ecbf8dd60606852c0aae.png[/img]

Once you have all 12 trading cards to complete the set, you will be able to craft a badge. There are 5 regular badges and one foil badge. Level 1 requires collecting the set 1 time, and 5 times for Level 5.

And finally the foil badge is earned only after collecting a set of rare foil trading cards (GOOD LUCK).


[h1]Emoticons & Backgrounds[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/dcbe611d9e560746134c7c26ac8bffcc692c6a56.png[/img]

Crafting a badge doesn’t only grant you that badge, it also grants a single custom emoticon which can be used in chat on Steam, or traded on the Steam Marketplace - as well as 1 Galacticare Steam background to decorate your profile as you wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/fe8c063c15ef44b8cd4f8e848cadd6e0cdbc4004.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/9e126bad432ca76b4929dd2e31035ebea947e124.jpg[/img]

And that's it for this week, best of luck earning all your Trading Cards and Badges!
Let us know which ones you'll be looking to add to your collections.

Until next time Director,
Brightrock & CULT

notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Greetings Directors! We've been very very busy so this will be a big one.

[h1]Game Systems & Balance[/h1]

[h2]Economy & Fines[/h2]
[i]Overall, we feel players are currently receiving too much income from treatments, especially when they optimise their hospitals with upgrades and consultants. We’ve lowered the base treatment income a little bit, and increased the starting amount of credits you start with to ensure the initial construction phase isn’t too punishing.[/i]
[list]
[*]Income from treatments reduced by 12%
[*]Starting credits increased from 75,000 to 100,000
[*]You can no longer set staff salaries to negative amounts (regardless of how passionate they may be about their job)
[*]Fixed fines not applying when kicking patients out of the hospital
[/list]

[h2]Treatment & Patient Health[/h2]
[i]The impact of both research and higher level doctors wasn’t being felt quite enough, so treatments are now overall a bit harder, and patients will lose more health whilst waiting - whereas doctor levels and research levels now both provide larger bonuses.[/i]
[list]
[*] Base treatment difficulty increased from -30 to -35
[*] Treatment bonus from doctor rank increased from +5 to +6 (per rank)
[*] Treatment bonus from research increased from +5 to +6 (per research level)
[*] Danger Level 1 condition health decay increased by 36%
[*] Danger Level 2 condition health decay increased by 36%
[*] Danger Level 3 condition health decay increased by 36%
[*] Danger Level 4 condition health decay decreased by 2.5%
[/list]

[h2]Disruptive Patient Spawner[/h2]
[i]The disruptive patient spawner is responsible for disrupting your hospital, but these disruptive patient waves weren’t being felt enough once your hospital reached a certain size. This system is now slower to ramp up, but later in it will spawn larger, more dangerous waves of patients for you to deal with.[/i]
[list]
[*] Now more likely to spawn patients with lower starting health
[*] Minimum wave size reduced (when the hospital is small)
[*] Maximum wave size increased (when the hospital is large)
[*] No longer kicks in immediately when the hospital is opened in sandbox mode
[/list]

[h2]Character Mood & Needs[/h2]
[i]Simply put, doctors were not using the Staff Lounge enough. We’ve made a round of changes to nudge them towards taking more regular breaks focused primarily on the staff lounge. Additionally, you now need to work slightly harder to keep everyone happy.[/i]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the needs system so staff will now primarily take breaks to visit the Staff Lounge, and will make use of vending machines and toilets far less often
[*] Characters now have a base mood of 40 (down from 50)
[*] Patients will now make use of toilets and vending machines much more often
[*] Patients are now more likely to use toilets and vending machines shortly after entering the hospital
[*] Staff are less likely to need to use toilets and vending machines shortly after entering the hospital
[*] Vizarj now need to use the toilet more frequently than other species (as it's their only physical need)
[/list]

[h2]Congestion[/h2]
[i]The congestion system was being hampered by a number of bugs. These have now been resolved, and we’ve made a few minor balance changes to smooth the system out.[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused Kouber Baly characters to never forget about any congestion they observed
[*] Tweaked some thresholds to make congestion overall a bit less sensitive
[*] Fixed an issue which caused Loamgates, escalators and elevators to produce a large amount of congestion
[*] Improved some text, tooltips, and icons associated with the congestion system
[/list]

[h2]Hospital Rating[/h2]
[i]We’ve made some adjustments to the hospital rating system to better balance the difficulty of each category, instead of some categories being universally much easier than others to max out. We also fixed a very impactful bug which caused decorations inside rooms to not count towards species desires.[/i]
[list]
[*] Throughput rating requirement reduced by ~20% (this requirement scales based on the size of the map)
[*] Finance rating requirement reduced by ~20% (this requirement scales based on the size of the map)
[*] "Good" threshold for Patient Mood increased from 80% to 85%
[*] "Good" threshold for Staff Mood increased from 80% to 85%"Good" threshold for Success Rate reduced from 95% to 90%
[*] Patient Health rating now has a larger impact on your overall Hospital Rating
[*] Additional minor adjustments to other thresholds throughout the system
[*] Fixed deaths in treatment rooms not being tracked most of the time (now those deaths really are just statistics)
[*] Fixed an issue which caused decorations in rooms to not count towards species desires & hospital rating
[*] Fixed hospital rating sometimes erroneously being rounded up in the UI, making it seem like you have reached 5 stars when you actually haven't (sorry, you'll need to try a bit harder!)
[/list]

[h2]Pricing Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Medibot: 20k (200 Craftium) → 40k Credits (400 Craftium)
[*] Stabilising Solution: 3k (30 Craftium) → 2k Credits (20 Craftium)
[*] Repair Kit: 3k (30 Craftium) → 2k Credits (20 Craftium)
[*] Technique Monitor: 30k (300 Craftium) → 20k Credits (200 Craftium)
[*] Bio Analyser: 30k (300 Craftium) → 20k Credits (200 Craftium)
[*] Subsonic Dampener: 30k (300 Craftium) → 20k Credits (200 Craftium)
[*] Regenerative Nanites: 40k (400 Craftium) → 30k Credits (300 Craftium)
[*] Critter Lure: 30k (300 Craftium) → 40k Credits (400 Craftium)
[*] Genetic Replicator: 25k (250 Craftium) → 20k Credits (200 Craftium)
[*] Training Room: 10k → 3k
[*] Training Room Matrix: 1k → 1.5k
[*] Recovery Ward: 10k → 3k
[*] Recovery Ward Bed: 1k → 1.5k
[/list]

[h2]Other Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reputation gains from treatment increased by 25%
[*] Loamble collection reward: 1 Loamite → 2 Loamite
[*] Holo-Docs now generate 50% reduced income from their treatments
[*] Regenerative Nanites health boost: +15 → +20
[*] Subsonic Dampener damage protection: 85% → 95%
[*] Nourishment Module need reduction: 75% → 90%
[*] Ohde Energy Collector: 15 credits per second → 5 credits per second
[/list]


[h1]Campaign[/h1]

[h2]Chapter 1[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[list]

[list]

[/list]

[*] Fixed canister avatars in the Dramarium not receiving the correct material
[/list]


[h1]User Interface[/h1]

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Doctors now display their currently-assigned room in the staff management panel even when they are on break (and you can also lock and unlock them whilst they are on break)
[*] Added a dedicated "default" cursor mode button next to the other cursor mode buttons (this improves the flow when switching in and out of other modes, such as the crafting mode)
[*] Clicking on any of the "Inspect [X]" in the objective panel will now pan the camera to that thing
[*] Added a Support link to the pause menu (PC only)
[*] The initial loading screen will now display "Loading..." in your own language, instead of internal debug messages
[*] Mousing over any whereabouts text will now display the full message in a tooltip, even if the original text was truncated due to its length
[*] Most room upgrades and consumables now list numerical information in their tooltip (eg: how much of an XP boost you gain from the Technique Monitor) (Note: this change is English only for now, other languages will gain this in an upcoming update)
[*] Character skins are no longer categorised as art in the galactic exchange
[/list]

[h2]UI Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused some UI panels to refuse to open (or close immediately upon being opened)

[*] Fixed staff level labels spilling out of their box in the staff management screen
[*] Additional safeties added to the recruitment panel portraits
[/list]


[h1]Other[/h1]

[h2]Game Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an accessibility option to disable screen shake effects
[*] Added a control option to enable free look when holding the middle mouse button
[*] Added control options to invert pitch & rotation
[*] "Subtitle Size" has been renamed to "Dialogue Text Size"
[*] "Environmental Dialogue Volume" has been renamed to "Environment Volume" (it always was environment volume
[/list]

[h2]Localisation[/h2]

[*] Updated some German localisation to use slightly more modern language
[*] Fixed some text in the room creation panel bleeding out in certain languages
[*] Improved the appearance of the consultant skill tree when playing in some languages
[*] Fixed some missing localisation in the hospital rating panel

[*] Fixed some typos in the French localisation
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[*] Improved the way recruits are generated - the frist recruit can now be anything, instead of being a guaranteed trainee (instead, the last recruit will now be a guaranteed trainee if you don't already have one available)
[*] Babylo Getaway (the first sandbox map) is now unlocked after completing Chapter 2 (not Chapter 1)
[*] When starting Sandbox a new sandbox you now begin with 500 Craftium
[/list]

[h2]Additional Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed canisters very occasionally not being able to find a path to a treatment room
[*] Fixed a rare occurance of calls not appearing when they should
[*] Fixed some occurrences of patients sitting in the air, opposite a bench
[*] Fixed an issue which caused patients to attempt to vomit mid-treatment

[*] Fixed the Overflow Tank decoration not being placeable anywhere but a Skin Lab
[*] Fixed patients killed by malpractice being incorrectly marked as being killed by a malfunction (own up to your mistakes, please)

[*] Fixed some of Twiggy Pop's dialogue being a bit too quiet

[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes interaction points in rooms could be blocked by decorative objects, making the room non-functional
[*] Fixed various issues with the system that teleports characters and other objects away from newly-constructed rooms
[*] Fixed an issue where consultants would sometimes not enter the hospital with their previously-selected skin
[*] Fixed long queue notifications for reception desks being offset from the desk
[*] Fixed an issue which caused staff to not train in the Training Room despite being manually assigned there
[*] Fixed a very rare issue which caused all movement logic in the game to cease functioning
[*] Fixed lenses painting tiles in outer space, instead of just inside the hospital
[*] Fixed various issues with consultant personal goals
[*] Fixed several sandbox events showing the wrong condition icon in the objective panel
[*] Fixed an issue which caused Medibots to sometimes be highlighted in red when placing them
[*] Lens highlights should now correctly disable during cutscenes
[*] Fixed an edge case where returning shuttles would not be detected by the level script - after a short window the script will now continue regardless
[*] Fixed Baz's Lucky Tooth not actually speeding up the merchant cooldown
[*] Fixed characters sometimes not facing forwards in their character portraits
[/list]

notes.title: First Week & State of the Game
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Director,[/b]

[b]Welcome back to Galacticare Wednesday![/b] It’s been just under one week since Galacticare took its first stride to the stars - and what a week it’s been!

Before we get into that though check out this awesome cake featuring the undeniably attractive Baz.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/910da16513b39aa0b92c247a04940d7a2094f4b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]150,000 Directors[/h2]

We’re very pleased with how the game has been received thus far, with over 150,000 new directors joining Galacticare’s ranks across all platforms and stores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/4748b872d930d66a73938780afaf0a94de794905.png[/img]

We’re incredibly pleased with how well the game has been received. The style, sensibility, humour, narrative, visuals and gameplay are all resonating well, and that means we already have something special on our hands.

But that doesn’t make it perfect, and it was certainly never going to be perfect. We’re tracking feedback and engaging with the community daily across [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/494730/discussions/]Steam[/url], [url=http://Discord.gg/brightrockgames]Discord[/url] and beyond to work out where we can deliver improvements so that everyone can enjoy the game more. So please read on, but also drop us a line in the comments, discussion threads or our Discord - we’re really eager to hear your feedback!


[h2]Patch 1.0.4[/h2]

As you may already be aware, we’ve deployed two updates since launch: v1.0.2 and v1.0.3, but we’re not stopping there and are hard at work on v1.0.4, which fixes several commonly-reported issues:
- Decorative species desires not being fulfilled by decorations in rooms
- Doctors not using Training Room when manually assigned
- Doctors only using the Staff Lounge very infrequently
- Consultant goals not progressing
- Congestion issues
And much, much more.

This update also brings an initial set of balance tweaks based on community feedback, as well as a number of camera control options (including the ability to disable camera shake).

We’re hoping to have v1.0.4 with you as soon as possible. It’ll be coming to Steam first, followed by GOG and PS5 shortly after. Xbox & PC Game Pass builds are currently slightly behind due to platform certification requirements, but we’re hoping to get closer to parity in the coming weeks and months.

We’re working hard to patch everything that gets reported to us, so if you encounter any issues please do give us a shout on our [url=https://support.brightrockgames.com]support site[/url] and follow the instructions on [url=https://support.brightrockgames.com/knowledge-bases/21/articles/8440-reporting-a-bug-or-crash-galacticare]how to report issues to the highest quality.[/url]


[h2]Difficulty[/h2]

We’ve been following the discussion surrounding the game’s difficulty with great interest, and we agree with the sentiment that Galacticare should provide a more challenging gameplay experience for more experienced management game players.

Galacticare has long been envisioned as a game with a very low barrier to entry, while also having a number of additional systems for more experienced players to play with. The goal was that these systems were all opt-in, and not required in order for less experienced players to be able to succeed at the game.  

In essence: It’s all actually working as intended, but our intent wasn’t quite on target.

We’ve come to the conclusion that lowering the barrier to entry this much has resulted in a number of these gameplay systems feeling superfluous for players who are experienced in the genre. If you’re already doing well, why make use of upgrades, consultants, and other tools?

It’s still very early days, but we’re looking into a number of options to provide that challenging experience without compromising on the low barrier to entry (which, based on feedback, is preferable to a large portion of the audience!).

v1.0.4 will bring a few minor balance changes, and we’ve begun testing a much wider set of difficulty-focused balance changes internally this week. We’ll have more information on that soon™


That’s about all we have for you today, thanks for taking the time to read through and thank you for trying out Galacticare! We expect that there’s a bright future ahead!

Until next time Director,

Brightrock & CULT

notes.title: The Dreamarium
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back to Galacticare Wednesday[/b]

This week we wanted to officially introduce the Dreamarium, a treatment designed to rearrange what goes on inside a patients head.

This quick introduction video will let you in on the basics of how this treatment works:
[previewyoutube=hP7TcG47bHA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Description[/h2]

The Dreamarium creature stays idle on it's platform with 2 beds on either side of it. One bed for the doctor and the other for the patient.

In front of the creature is a pad for where the creature projects images of the patient's subconscious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/c77c853914e80d84411cfbc06c81500552ec728c.png[/img]

[h2]Treatment Process[/h2]

[b]Phase 1[/b] - The beds position the doctor and patient next to the creature, ready for treatment.

[b]Phase 2[/b] - The creature acts as a bridge between the minds of the doctor and patient, allowing the doctor to cure the patient.

Images of the patient's mind can be seen projected onto the pad throughout.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHhrczFtY3F3cHFkYndrbGI2dHdkd3FiYTBqcW44NjN4MHhzenB6MyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3iRhYms0h1PtxWcNQj/giphy.gif[/img]

The Dreamium is also the perfect place for some of our favourite brain related props in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/807d086532132cdd590bb590eb111b5ff479998c.png[/img]
Brain food (Left) - Brain Wash (Right)

And that’s all for this week, not much longer until you can build & run your own Dreamarium! A lot of questions have come up about release dates and what we can say is the wait won’t be much longer now - the entire team is in full focus mode to get the game ready so you may notice us going a little quieter during this period.

For now, Galacticare Wednesdays & Condition Treatment Journals will be coming out once every 2 weeks so we can prioritise on the game while also making sure you all have a little bit of content to enjoy in the meantime!

We'll be keeping you updated all through our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@galacticare]TikTok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Galacticare?ref=blog.galacticare.com]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/brightrockgames]Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Surgery in the club - Welcome to Laser Surgery
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back to Galacticare Wednesday![/b]

This week we’re covering another treatment room, this time it’s Laser Surgery. This one is a personal favourite of mine for multiple reasons, one of them being that the room basically turns into a nightclub during surgery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/cfa9770d8cae1aab79645a53b96311a6651d077f.png[/img]

The sound design team at Zimmer Audio did an amazing job here with the SFX for this room:

[previewyoutube=HuH2DCVrnis;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Description[/h2]

Laser Surgery is a surgical treatment where a doctor controls drones armed with mining lasers to perform intricate procedures. 

The Laser Surgery table has a standard operating bed that seamlessly adjusts between vertical and horizontal positions. Concealed beneath the floor are two laser drones, hidden behind access ports they can use to fly in and out of.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcHhhYzFld2s3emJoaTJjbWgzZGczaGF3MnZreTZrbTMzMzBid2x5biZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/payk2e0wONYWHQcu6J/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

A couple of the room theme items include a DJ turntable and speakers. While surgery is being performed you can see the room turn darker and the walls become audio visualisers with soundwaves and neon lights. A fun detail added to this room for when it breaks down, you might notice the walls actually break as well and fill the room with error codes.


[h2]Treatment Process[/h2]

As treatment begins, the doctor positions themselves at the terminal and the patient is pulled onto the operating table. The doctor then interacts with the terminal, triggering the main prop to glow with neon edges and the emergence of the laser drones from their ports. The doctor skillfully pilots the drones to fire the right lasers in the right places. The main prop finally reverts to its initial appearance, and the drones return to their ports as the successfully cured patient exits the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/bcd3b0b77d0d7018453c074240db6b746c86e498.png[/img]

Each treatment has different variations depending on the condition and the type of lasers the drone uses. A few of the different laser types include: Cutting Lasers, Healing/Stictching Lasers, Cooling/Heating Lasers & Destruction Beams.


That's all for the Laser Surgery introduction, there's always plenty more to learn about all the rooms and conditions in game so if you're a fan of lore then stay tuned.

Don’t forget we publish a new deep-dive blog post once a month, and more weekly explorations (including daily Condition Research Journals) across our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@galacticare?ref=blog.galacticare.com]TikTok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Galacticare?ref=blog.galacticare.com]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/brightrockgames?ref=blog.galacticare.com]Discord[/url].

See you next week for another instalment of Galacticare Wednesday!

notes.title: Galacticare Wednesday - Craftech
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Director,[/b]

Welcome to another Galacticare Wednesday!

Introducing Craftech.

Craftech arose from our desire to take a leaf out of the god game design book and give players much more direct power and control than you might traditionally find in a management game. 

As this notion is something fairly alien (heh) to the genre, the various systems and components went through many, many iterations, but our primary goal remained the same: We wanted to give players an arsenal of tools and powers to quite literally take their hospital to the next level.

[h2]Types of Craftech[/h2]
[h3]Room Upgrades[/h3]
First up, room upgrades. Each room can be equipped with an upgrade that can dramatically improve or change how it operates.

For example, the [b]Holo-Doc Emitter[/b] will - as you may surmise - generate a holographic doctor to work in the room. This holographic doctor may seem like the perfect employee; it will work tirelessly without breaks (or even a salary!). However, they are not as effective as regular doctors, nor are they able to gain experience and level up.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Doe0kQriWojBhkGyJR/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Please state the nature of the medical emergency[/i]


Or you could opt for the [b]Efficiency Regulator[/b], which can triple the amount of credits that a room generates per treatment. These can be especially handy as you are growing your fledgling hospital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/866ea920f26257b6cce57263f7d50d63666b421c.jpg[/img]
[i]Sometimes, it is all about the money[/i]

[h3]Corridor Upgrades[/h3]
Outside of your rooms, there are also numerous Craftech items which can be used to enhance the corridors of your hospital.

The [b]Bio-Stasis Beacon[/b] projects a large aura which reduces the health decay of all patients in a large area. This can allow you to create effective waiting areas which keep patients alive (and able to pay their bills!) even if your wait times are excessive.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kV1gsD3HegcoDeipfW/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Stayin' alive, stayin' alive[/i]


And the [b]Teleportation Pad[/b] does exactly as you’d expect: It can instantly teleport both patients and staff across the hospital to any other Teleportation Pads you have built.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Gf9EOSGY3Ty0dOCgCa/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Beam me up![/i]

[h3]Consumables[/h3]
Finally, we have one-use consumable items. Usually you’ll gain these in packs of two or more, allowing you to use them fairly liberally.

You can make use of some [b]Stabilising Solution[/b] to fully restore the health of a single patient by simply dropping it on top of them. This will allow you to bring a patient back from the brink of death, giving you plenty of time in which to treat them. Ideal for emergency situations where you find yourself overwhelmed.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ks00iv1wmvjP17JhI6/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Saving the galaxy, one patient at a time… but not that one[/i]


If you find yourself particularly attached to a particular doctor, why limit yourself to just one of them? The [b]Genetic Replicator[/b] allows you to clone any of your non-Consultant doctors. It’s perfectly painless. Probably.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/yuYDZ78emAwcP0ZaQx/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]This is getting out of hand.gif[/i]

[h2][strike]Rules[/strike] Methods of Acquisition[/h2]
[h3]Mission Rewards[/h3]
The first and most straightforward method of acquiring Craftech is by completing objectives. Every task completed will grant a bevy of rewards, including a handful of Craftech items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/42935cca8efeb3ec901b677ead8c362e2e2664cb.png[/img]
[i]Once you have their money, you never give it back[/i]


Generally these will be geared towards the mission you’re currently on, but you’re always able to salvage any Craftech items you don’t want to use. Speaking of which…

[h3]Blueprints & Crafting[/h3]
The first time you encounter a new Craftech item you’ll automatically be given its blueprint. Using Craftium (which, as you may guess, is the special crafting resource) you’ll be able to craft more of any Craftech item you have a blueprint for. Any blueprints you have are taken with you from level to level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/677ad31c529e64332ab321ec812eb5268e26c387.png[/img]
[i]Knowledge equals profit[/i]


As mentioned above, you can gain Craftium by salvaging any Craftech items you don’t want to keep, and you’ll also get some Craftium every time you complete an objective. You can also collect Craftium by catching Craftles, friendly critters which are attracted to your hospital by decorative objects (we’ll be talking more about critters in a future blog post!).

To further enhance your crafting exploits, you can research advanced blueprints in the Research Lab. These advanced blueprints will allow you to craft items at a significant discount, allowing you to more efficiently specialise in the upgrades and items you enjoy using the most.

[h3]Baz, the Travelling Merchant[/h3]
Bazzanorrothogoria (or ‘Baz’ to his friends), a Colossal you meet at the beginning of the game, will routinely visit the hospital to offer you a random selection of Craftech items in exchange for your hand-earned credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/35a3091bb968c104fa6f0b5c8cf5ab37fd76dece.png[/img]
[i]Never spend more for an acquisition than you have to[/i]


Baz will also always offer you a free item as thanks for helping him out, so it’s always worth checking the shop out when he visits even if you can’t afford to buy anything!

[h2]Crafting Craftech[/h2]
The various systems involved went through many iterations over the past few years. Most notably, many of these components began life as independent features before eventually being wrapped up into Craftech.

For example, room upgrades were originally going to be small, invisible stat enhancements with space for up to three upgrades per room. As the system evolved, we pivoted to only allowing one upgrade in order to allow them to be much more powerful (such as the Holo-Doc described above).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/7319d9529791504cfa5da7b50564dc7105d586ae.png[/img]
[i]Original UI mock-up for room upgrades, circa 2020[/i]


The primary driver for this change was us wanting each individual decision to be more meaningful and impactful. Three upgrades which provide +50% money, research or experience each aren’t super exciting on their own, but an upgrade which triples the income from one room? That’s much more noticeable.

We also eventually decided to give these upgrades a physical presence in the world. We initially made the decision for them to be “invisible” so they didn’t get in the way of your all-important decorations, but the desire to be able to physically see and interact with the upgrades eventually won out.

The compromise was to significantly limit their footprint in order to maximise the amount of space available for plants, sculptures, skeletons, and whatever else you may wish to adorn your treatment rooms with. A small footprint doesn’t necessarily mean a small object, though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/fd45d35faf3e72cc2a6bb7e6f222abf4ade2013b.png[/img]
[i]Harder, better, faster, stronger[/i]


We landed on these high-tech totem pole-like devices to represent our various upgrades. As with all our decorative objects they will dynamically recolour themselves to match the room they are in*, so they’ll fit in with any style of decor you choose for your Boning Chamber.

[i]*You can, of course, individually recolour any object at any time if you aren’t a fan of consistent colour schemes.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759370/d48f1dc3217a2e0f9922421255474e81e297baba.jpg[/img]

Outside of your rooms, there are also numerous Craftech items which can be used to enhance the corridors of your hospital.
The [b]Bio-Stasis Beacon[/b] projects a large aura which reduces the health decay of all patients in a large area.
And the [b]Teleportation Pad[/b] does exactly as you’d expect: It can instantly teleport both patients and staff across the hospital to any other Teleportation Pads you have built.
